name: S&B Cold Air Intake with Dry Extendable Filter (20-26 3.0L Duramax Silverado 1500)

visible.author: TedT
visible.title: Quality intake, great sound, tough install
visible.body: I installed the S&B cold air intake on my 2026 Chevrolet Silverado 1500 3.0L Duramax and am very satisfied with the overall result. The build quality is excellent. All components feel durable and well-designed, and the instructions were very detailed and easy to follow, which helped set expectations going into the install. The most noticeable improvement was immediate—turbo sound and airflow. The intake really brings out the turbo noise and gives the truck a more responsive feel. While it’s difficult to quantify performance gains, the improved airflow is clearly noticeable and makes the upgrade worthwhile. Installation was more challenging than expected. The fit is extremely tight, and you will need to remove multiple components to make space. I had to take out the coolant reservoir and other surrounding parts just to get the factory airbox out and the new unit in. Replacing the factory intake tube was the most difficult part. The engine bay is very tight, and the factory clamps were tough to remove. In my case, the hose was stuck to the turbo inlet, which made removal even more difficult. It required patience, persistence, and working in awkward positions to get everything out and reinstalled properly. The full installation took about 4–5 hours. At times it felt like I wouldn’t get it completed, but once finished, the results made it worth the effort. If you’re looking for improved turbo sound and airflow, this is a great upgrade and I would absolutely do it again.
visible.product: S&B Cold Air Intake with Dry Extendable Filter (20-26 3.0L Duramax Silverado 1500)

visible.author: Daniel
visible.title: Easier with help
visible.body: Read the instructions. They were very clear and made install simple. Extra hands will help with holding things out of the way when installing the new breather box. An instruction book would be better then using your phone. The factory breather tube slides in hard you will need to hold the rubber gasket from the inside of the box while you push the breather tube in to it, If you dont it will push the rubber seal out.
visible.product: S&B Cold Air Intake with Dry Extendable Filter (20-26 3.0L Duramax Silverado 1500)

visible.author: JohnDunn
visible.title: 2024 Duramax Cold Air Intake Install
visible.body: The product itself is great once you can install it. Sounds amazing, better mileage, the normal stuff with installing a cold air intake. However, the only downside is that the instructions do not clearly cover how to install the additional tubing up to the turbo intake, and additional parts need to be removed to give adequate access. Other than that, the instructions are very clear and the product functions better than I could’ve imagined
visible.product: S&B Cold Air Intake with Dry Extendable Filter (20-26 3.0L Duramax Silverado 1500)

visible.author: TKODuramax
visible.title: Great Product! 3.0L Duramax
visible.body: I'm not a big review writer but after installing this product it was a game changer. The pickup after installing was noticeable right away, there is no delay when you give it gas. The sound it has now, friends and neighbors said they can hear a difference when I roll up. You also can hear the whistle while you are driving. If you follow the instructions, it isn't bad at all. The only issue I had with (choice words) was getting the old airflow tube out on a 2021 Chevy Silverado 3.0 Duramax, but that is a GM flaw with the tight engine compartment. I will give a big shout out to American Trucks on the order process and the shipping. Once ordered it showed up 3-4 days later even with a holiday and had it installed the day it was delivered. Good luck to anyone that installs it themselves, but the frustration is worth it.

visible.author: Bamahamma
visible.title: Awesome product!
visible.body: This product takes a significant amount of patience to install. I installed on a 2025 Duramax 1500. There are slight differences in the install instructions for the 2025 model year that have not been updated yet. But these are easy to figure out if you are mechanically inclined. Looking forward to experiencing o the benefits of this product!!
